rendering_dependency.purpose: Local deterministic SVG rendering probe; no dependency installed into the application repository.

observations: Generated 6 container skins from one shared 3-node/2-edge logical model.
Repeated render with the same dependency and parameters produced byte-identical SVG.
All 6 SVG groups retain 3 node records, 2 internal edge records and 2 boundary ports.
Text remains SVG text; PNG is only the preview.
PNG preview rendered with rsvg-convert and visually inspected.
limits: This is a research rendering probe, not an editor.
No PPTX or draw.io file was generated or tested.
Drag behavior, style round-trip fidelity, small physical-size legibility and real-paper reconstruction remain proposed evaluations.
